explanation: Mathlib has the two pieces separately: `MvPolynomial.mem_map_C_iff_coeff_mem` for `Ideal.map C I`, and `MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image` (in RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Ideal.lean) for `Ideal.span (X '' S)`. The library's proof combines both, but I found no Mathlib declaration describing membership in their sup `Ideal.map C I ⊔ Ideal.span (X '' S)`. I read all of RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Ideal.lean, which covers the monomial-ideal lemmas and the `idealOfVars` results. I also grepped Mathlib for sups that contain `map C` or `span (X ...)`, including single-variable `Polynomial` versions. The only hit was `Ideal.MonicSpan` (`(p.comap C).map C ⊔ span {f}`), which is a different result. Deriving the theorem from Mathlib takes the full two-direction argument the library gives, so it is not a short special case.
